title: Balance CDQ V22.30 — PC bas + gauche + icône + mur

patches.text:
<style id="cdqPcV2230PcFixes">
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-body{grid-template-columns:182px minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:8px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-sidebar{width:auto!important;height:732px!important;margin:0!important;border:1px solid #1e5874!important;border-radius:7px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#061622 0%,#04131d 70%,#05141f 100%)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-center{height:732px!important;}
html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"],html.windows #cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"] *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;}
html.pc16-startup-lock,html.pc16-startup-lock body,html.pc16-startup-lock #accessOverlay{background:#050608 url("https://jprodrigue86.github.io/Rapports--talonnages-CDQ/assets/music-wall-choice1.webp?v=20260918-v2230") center center / cover no-repeat fixed!important;}
</style>
<script id="cdqPcV2230PcFixesJs">
(function(){
function fix(){
 var r=document.getElementById('cdqPcV16');if(r)r.dataset.build='v22.30-pc-bas-gauche-icone-mur';
 document.querySelectorAll('#cdqPcV16 .pc16-side-meta span').forEach(function(x){x.textContent='V22.30';});
 var card=document.querySelector('#cdqPcV16 .pc16-kpi[data-follow="clients"]');
 if(card){var ico=card.querySelector('.ico');if(ico){ico.dataset.v2225='1';ico.style.animation='none';ico.style.transition='none';}}
}
function watch(){var k=document.getElementById('pc16Kpis');if(!k||k.dataset.v2230watch==='1')return;k.dataset.v2230watch='1';new MutationObserver(fix).observe(k,{childList:true,subtree:true});fix();}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){fix();watch();},{once:true});else{fix();watch();}
window.addEventListener('load',function(){setTimeout(function(){fix();watch();},80);},{once:true});
})();
</script>

notes: Marge d'auto-fit augmentée pour rendre le bas visible
Panneau gauche restauré sans marge qui coupe le cadre
Clients chargés stabilisé en bloquant le remplacement répété de l'icône
